reason: Hypothesis B is more physically sound and specific: it proposes a TiAl-based composite with Cu and in situ ceramic particles (NbC/TiC), which aligns directly with the cited evidence showing hardness increases from 642 to 1048 HV via TiAlCu/NbC coatings.
